units.source_text: 最使千重子感到吃惊的是，倘使不经常把别处的雄金钟儿放进壶里，

en.t: What surprised Chieko most was that if male bell crickets from elsewhere were not regularly put into the jar,

units.source_text: 只让同一个壶里的金钟儿自行繁殖，那么新生的幼虫就会变得瘦小体弱。

en.t: and the crickets in the same jar were simply left to breed among themselves, the newly hatched larvae would become small, thin, and weak.

units.source_text: 那是反复近亲交配的缘故。

en.t: That was because of repeated inbreeding.

units.source_text: 为了避免这种情况，金钟儿爱好者都有交换雄金钟儿的习惯。

en.t: To avoid this, bell cricket enthusiasts all had the custom of exchanging male crickets.
